title: Board: replace the 5 s worktree status poll with RepoWatch
body: Planning card: design first, then implement. The board polls card worktree status every STATUS_POLL_INTERVAL (src/kanban.rs); RepoWatch (src/git_history/watch.rs) could drive it on change instead. Open questions: RepoWatch is pub(super) inside git_history and must be exposed; the main checkout's watch ignores .foreman/worktrees/, so each card tree needs its own watch (or a new mode); a watch must never hold a tree teardown wants gone (watch.rs already exits on root delete, and a test pins that); keep polling as the fallback where there is no watch (network paths). See docs/git-history.md 'Repository watch'.
blocked_reason: Integration queue held by uncommitted src/git_history/watch.rs in the shared main checkout; commit e77cea7 is clean and queued behind another card.
